bio: Escape the every day to our charming St Peter Port resort, Fermain Valley Hotel & Spa, for the ultimate, quintessential dining experience. Stunning coastal views create the perfect backdrop to indulge in Afternoon Tea with us.  Afternoon Tea at Fermain Valley Hotel & Spa is served in the Valley Tea Rooms with beautiful views over our grounds, and to the sea beyond. In warmer months, you can also enjoy Afternoon Tea alfresco. Our elegant yet relaxed setting makes it the perfect spot to unwind and indulge in this British tradition.  Enjoy the age-old tradition of a traditional Afternoon Tea with our menu which includes an array of savoury treats, scones, and sweet pastries, along with a wide selection of loose-leaf teas. Our talented pastry chefs prepare the scones and cakes freshly each day. We also refresh our menu regularly to celebrate various occasions and celebrations throughout the year.  We pride ourselves on catering for a wide range of dietary requirements including gluten-free, vegan, and special children's Afternoon Tea options. As the crowning touch, upgrade your traditional experience with a glass of Champagne or Prosecco for the height of luxury.
